name: minimax-vscode-copilot
description: Language model provider for GitHub Copilot in VS Code: use MiniMax M2.7 / M2.7-highspeed / M3 models for programming with a Token Plan API key over the Anthropic-compatible API. Does not add speech, video, or image generation APIs.

minimax.apiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: MiniMax Anthropic-compatible API base URL. **Deprecated.** The active key's endpoint (selected automatically by `MiniMax: Add API Key` or `MiniMax: Re-probe Active API Key`) is the source of truth; this setting is consulted only as a fallback when the named-key pool is empty. Use `https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic` for users in China, or `https://api.minimax.io/anthropic` for international users. The Anthropic SDK appends `/v1/messages` automatically.
minimax.apiBaseUrl.deprecationMessage: Read by KeyManager only as a fallback when no named API key is configured. Use 'MiniMax: Add API Key' to bind an endpoint to a key. This setting will be removed in 3.0.

minimax.apiKey.markdownDescription: Fallback MiniMax API key when SecretStorage is unavailable (e.g. CI/automation). Prefer the in-product API key navigation action, which stores the key in SecretStorage.

minimax.visibleModels.markdownDescription: Programming text models (M2.7 / M2.7-highspeed / M3) for Token Plan. M3 is the latest native-multimodal frontier coding model (officially 1M context; effective 512K until the >512K tier is fully rolled out). `MiniMax-M3-Priority` is the same upstream model routed via `service_tier: "priority"` for faster responses and lower failure rate, billed at 1.5× the standard per-token rate. MiniMax no longer recommends M2.5 and earlier.

minimax.maxOutputTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum number of **output** tokens per response (sent as `max_tokens` in the Anthropic request body). `0` (default) lets the model decide; the upstream API is responsible for any per-model ceiling. Set a positive integer to cap the output yourself; the value is sent verbatim and any 4xx from the upstream is surfaced as-is. **This is the output cap, not the context window** — see `minimax.enableM31MContext` for the input/context window.

minimax.maxTokens.markdownDescription: **Deprecated:** renamed to `minimax.maxOutputTokens` for clarity. The value is still read as a fallback when `minimax.maxOutputTokens` is unset, so existing `settings.json` entries keep working. This key will be removed in 3.0.

minimax.enableM31MContext.markdownDescription: Lift the **MiniMax-M3** and **MiniMax-M3-Priority** context windows advertised in the model picker from the safe default of 512,000 to the official 1,000,000-token cap. **Off by default.** Enabling this unlocks the >512K input tier only if your MiniMax account has been granted access; otherwise the upstream API will return HTTP 400 for requests above 512K. The >512K tier is billed at **1.5× the per-token rate** of the standard tier for standard M3 and at **3×** for M3-Priority (see the [pricing page](https://platform.minimaxi.com/docs/guides/pricing-paygo)). Prefer the **MiniMax: Toggle M3 1M Context** command — it surfaces the warnings inline before flipping the switch.

minimax.debugMode.markdownDescription: Diagnostic verbosity. `verbose` writes full request payloads to `<globalStorage>/request-dumps/<segmentId>/` for debugging.

enumItemLabels: Trace (high-frequency details — turn on for a specific incident)
minimax.logLevel.markdownDescription: Minimum severity the `MiniMax` Output channel writes. Default `info` matches what the dashboard's lifecycle gate and the request/stream path emit under normal use. Set to `debug` or `trace` when investigating a specific incident, then drop back to `info` so the channel stays useful for the next one.

minimax.diagnostics.traceDashboard.markdownDescription: Emit trace-level log lines for dashboard open / refresh / webview-render lifecycle. Off by default — the dashboard already logs `info` events on every refresh; this flag turns on the per-checkpoint `trace` lines used when the user reports a stuck dashboard.

minimax.diagnostics.traceRequests.markdownDescription: Emit trace-level log lines for the request / stream lifecycle (header events, delta arrivals, usage accounting). Off by default; turn on when the user reports missing usage data or unexpected token counts.

minimax.diagnostics.traceMcp.markdownDescription: Emit trace-level log lines for the MiniMax MCP provider registration and resolution paths. Off by default; turn on when the Copilot MCP picker does not see the `MiniMax` server.

minimax.diagnostics.traceKeys.markdownDescription: Emit trace-level log lines for the named-key pool (add / probe / switch / activate / delete). Off by default; turn on when the user reports the wrong key being picked.

minimax.modelIdOverrides.markdownDescription: Map a Copilot picker model ID to the actual API model ID the upstream endpoint expects. The default `{}` means 'no override' — the picker ID is sent to the API verbatim (variants like `MiniMax-M3-Priority` still fall back to their registry-declared `apiModelId`). Useful when routing through a third-party proxy that uses different model names (e.g. `{"MiniMax-M3": "provider-internal-m3-001"}`). Mappings for IDs not in the picker are silently ignored. To re-add a historical model (M2.5 / M2.1 / M2) to the picker itself, also add it to `minimax.visibleModels`.

minimax.experimental.stabilizeToolList.markdownDescription: **Experimental.** When the Copilot host presents placeholder `activate_*` tools, synthesise preflight tool calls so the tool list stays stable across turns. Improves cache hit rate but adds extra round-trips. Restart the chat session after changing.

minimax.sampling.markdownDescription: Per-model sampling overrides. Map a model ID (`MiniMax-M3`, `MiniMax-M3-Priority`, `MiniMax-M2.7`, `MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed`) to a `{ temperature?, topP?, topK?, frequencyPenalty? }` object. Each field is optional; unset fields fall back to the API default. **Ignored when thinking is on** for `temperature` and `topP` (Anthropic's `thinking: { type: 'adaptive' }` constraint forces `temperature: 1` and drops `topP`). Restart the chat session after changing.

temperature.markdownDescription: Overrides `temperature`. `0` is greedy, `2` is most random.

topP.markdownDescription: Overrides `top_p` (nucleus sampling). Ignored when thinking is on.

topK.markdownDescription: Overrides `top_k` (sampling cutoff). Always honoured, including when thinking is on.

frequencyPenalty.markdownDescription: Overrides `frequency_penalty`. Always honoured, including when thinking is on.

minimax.dashboard.includeClaudeCode.markdownDescription: Include token usage from the Claude Code CLI and the Claude Code VSCode extension in the **Usage Dashboard**. Reads the same `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl` files those tools write. The cursor is persisted across restarts; disabling and re-enabling does not re-read everything. **On by default.**

minimax.claudeCode.logPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the directory containing Claude Code JSONL session logs. Defaults to `~/.claude/projects` (the same path Claude Code writes to on all platforms). The leading `~` is expanded to the user's home directory.

minimax.claudeCode.pollIntervalMs.markdownDescription: How often the dashboard's Claude Code ingester scans the log directory for new lines, in milliseconds. Default `30000` (30 s). Minimum `5000` (5 s); the lower the value, the more frequently the extension reads from disk.

minimax.claudeCode.allowedModels.markdownDescription: Allowlist of model IDs to count in the **Claude Code** section of the dashboard. The Claude Code JSONL log includes every model the Claude Code CLI / VSCode extension talked to (not just MiniMax), so we filter to MiniMax-related models by default. Edit this list to add or remove model IDs; the in-code fallback in `getClaudeCodeAllowedModels()` mirrors this list and is used when the setting is missing or malformed.

minimax.experimental.modelDefPresets.markdownDescription: **Experimental.** Per-model `extra` escape hatch. Map a model ID to an object whose keys are merged verbatim into the Anthropic request body. Reserved keys (`model`, `messages`, `stream`, `max_tokens`, `system`, `thinking`, `tools`, `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`, `frequency_penalty`) are ignored. Useful for `stop_sequences`, `service_tier`, or whatever MiniMax adds next.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: MiniMax Token Plan API key. Get it from platform.minimaxi.com (China) or platform.minimax.io (international), under Account / Token Plan.

scripts.package:dev: npm run build && npm run package
scripts.test:coverage: npm run compile:tests && c8 --exclude-after-remap --all --src src --include "**/*.ts" --exclude "test/**" --exclude "**/*.d.ts" --exclude "**/types.ts" --reporter=text --reporter=lcov node --test --test-isolation=process out-test/*.test.js
